scripts.generate: bun run link-local && bun run scripts/generate.ts
scripts.dev: bun run generate && bun --cwd apps/backend dev & bun --cwd apps/web dev
scripts.dev:backend: bun run generate && bun --cwd apps/backend dev
scripts.dev:web: bun run generate && bun --cwd apps/web dev
scripts.typecheck: bun run generate && bun --cwd apps/backend typecheck && bun --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.build: bun run generate && bun --cwd apps/backend build && bun --cwd apps/web build
scripts.smoke: bun run generate && bun run scripts/smoke.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run smoke
